en.admin.panel_enabled_ignored: PANEL_ENABLED is no longer read: the admin panel is controlled by ADMIN_PANEL (set ADMIN_PANEL=false to turn it off). Remove PANEL_ENABLED from your configuration.

fr.admin.panel_enabled_ignored: PANEL_ENABLED n'est plus lu : le panneau d'administration dépend de ADMIN_PANEL (mettez ADMIN_PANEL=false pour le désactiver). Retirez PANEL_ENABLED de votre configuration.
